scope: Offline Pythonic data/source execution; native/controller behavior unverified

positional_transfers.source: Complete individual Cartesian values or JOINTPOS width changes, using existing conversion helpers
positional_transfers.atomicity: Typed source capture, complete validation/conversion, stable destination identities and data/cache/status publication
positional_transfers.boundary: Exact same-type partial copies preserved; ARRAY elements, user nominal identities and joint/Cartesian kinematics remain exact or explicit

synchronous_calls.entry: New Pythonic ordinary output separates private body from standalone begin/terminal cleanup
synchronous_calls.ownership: Clone nested stacks, share prototype globals and caller budget/root/observations/group scopes; retain independently attached state
synchronous_calls.lifetime: Atomic non-yielding body; resumable pause-entry, no false callback-pause stack, runtime failure cleanup and sticky root abort
synchronous_calls.boundary: Cooperative targets retain existing scheduler behavior; old outputs need retranslation, no native/binary loader

samples_16bit.input: Explicit sample_bits=16 for grayscale/GA/RGB/RGBA, unsigned big-endian component bytes
samples_16bit.export: Matching 16-bit PNG header and sample rows without scaling; source BMP saves return unsupported status 2
samples_16bit.limits: Byte-aware quota checks before hex decoding, retained metadata through capture/find/register/context paths
samples_16bit.boundary: Legacy 8-bit artifacts unchanged; palettes remain 8-bit, no depth units, proprietary layouts, acquisition or rendering claim

strict_mode: Future milestone; preserved legacy ordinary output does not gain Pythonic private body
